about: A smoke run of the config below, pinned with the box's course sensed (45 inputs), so that a change of these numbers is a change of behaviour: a refactor must keep them. The event log's digest is exact on the machine type it was pinned on (macOS arm64): elsewhere the last bit of a float depends on the platform's libm and the SIMD kernels numpy picks for the CPU. The evaluations' digest, every number to 9 significant digits, holds everywhere.
config:
name = "pin"
[world.simulation]
max_steps = 200
[team]
agents = 10
[scenarios]
easy = 2
full = 2
held_out = 4
seed = 1
[evolution]
population = 10
generations = 4
[run]
backend = "numpy"
device = "cpu"
precision = "float64"
